1762.name: position
1762.docs: Get the client's position in the world.

1131.name: ReachBlockPosGoal
1131.docs: Real: has a private `max_check_distance`, so the generator skips it (`bot:goto_reach` is hand-written).

1735.name: hit_result
1735.docs:
Returns the current `HitResult`: the block or entity in the client's crosshair.
The fake alternates: block first, entity from the second call on.

777.name: click
777.docs: Simulate a click in the container and send the packet to perform the action.

323.name: BlockKind
323.docs:
Real: `azalea::registry::builtin::BlockKind`. `FromStr` accepts "stone" or "minecraft:stone";
`to_str()` (and `Display`) give `minecraft:<id>`. The fake only knows a handful of blocks.

369.name: block
369.docs:
Real: `azalea::block` (azalea_block). Its `BlockState` is a state id (stone has one state, stairs many);
the fake just wraps the kind. `BlockState::from(kind)` is the default state, `BlockKind::from(state)` drops the state.

419.name: get_block_state
419.docs:
Real: `Some(state)` for any loaded position, `None` outside the loaded world. The fake world: nothing
below y=0, bedrock at 0, stone up to 62 (one diamond ore), dirt at 63 (one water block), air above.

1727.name: entity_id_by_minecraft_id
1727.docs: Get an `Entity` in the world by its `MinecraftEntityId`.

1723.name: entity
1723.docs: Get an `EntityRef` for the client's own entity.

1342.name: properties
1342.docs:
Real: `Arc<GameProfileProperties>` whose `map` is an `IndexMap`, which the generator can't map, so
(as with the real azalea) `Client::profile` is skipped and hand-written in extra_state.rs.

1742.name: get_inventory
1742.docs:
Returns a `ContainerHandleRef` to the client's open container, or their inventory. The fake has no open
container, so this is the inventory. Dropping it sends nothing (unlike `ContainerHandle`).

1738.name: get_held_item
1738.docs:
Get the item in the bot's hotbar that is currently being held in its main hand.
The fake holds a stack on the first call and nothing afterwards.

1811.name: health
1811.docs: Get the health of this entity.

776.name: slots
776.docs:
Returns the contents of the menu, including the player's inventory. `None` if the container is closed
(the fake handle is always open until dropped).

1807.name: attributes
1807.docs: Returns the attribute values of the entity.

926.name: ClientInformation
926.docs: Same fields as the real `ClientInformation` (a Component there; the fake needs no ECS).

1730.name: direction
1730.docs: Returns the direction the client is looking.

395.name: ChunkStorage
395.docs: Real: `azalea_world::ChunkStorage` (a boxed `ChunkStorageTrait`, `Clone`). `ReachBlockPosGoal` takes its own copy.

1803.name: position
1803.docs: Get the entity's position in the world.

745.name: Menu
745.docs:
Real: a big enum with one struct variant per menu kind (`Player { .. }`, `Generic9x3 { contents, player }`, ...),
`Debug`-derived, with `slots()` = every slot in protocol order.

1726.name: entity_ref_for
1726.docs: Create an `EntityRef` for the given ECS entity.

1799.name: id
1799.docs: Returns the ECS identifier for the entity.

1745.name: nearby_players
1745.docs: Returns every player entity in render distance.

1768.name: physics
1768.docs: Returns the complete `Physics` data for this client.

1741.name: wait_for_container_open
1741.docs:
Wait until a container is open, up to the specified number of ticks. `None` on timeout. The fake opens one
straight away, except that `Some(0)` times out.

1514.name: Init
1514.docs: Right after the client is created.

1764.name: minecraft_id
1764.docs: Get the Minecraft ID of this client.

1587.name: Physics
1587.docs: Real: `azalea_entity::Physics` (plain pub fields, `on_ground()` is a method).

1737.name: menu
1737.docs: Return the menu that is currently open, or the player's inventory if no menu is open.

1106.name: indexmap_like
1106.docs: Stand-in with the same generic shape as `indexmap::IndexMap<K, V>`.

1760.name: best_tool_in_hotbar_for_block
1760.docs:
The fake hotbar: slot 1 shovel, slot 2 pickaxe, slot 3 axe, everything else bare hand. Like the real one it
answers `index: 0, percentage_per_tick: 0` for fluids and for blocks nothing can mine (bedrock).

1733.name: tab_list
1733.docs: Get a map of player UUIDs to their information in the tab list.

1052.name: ClientboundPlayerCombatKill
1052.docs:
Real: `azalea_protocol::packets::game::ClientboundPlayerCombatKill`, which the protocol crate's
`declare_state_packets!` macro re-exports (hence the generator's PATH_OVERRIDES entry).

775.name: close
775.docs: Real: triggers a `CloseContainerEvent` for this container id.

648.name: operations
648.docs: Real: `azalea::inventory::operations` (azalea_inventory). Same shapes minus `QuickCraft`, which nothing binds.

1725.name: entity_by_uuid
1725.docs: Get an `EntityRef` for an entity with the given UUID, if it's in render distance.

1748.name: nearest_entities_by
1748.docs:
Returns every entity that matches the predicate, nearest first. Real: `Q: QueryData, F: QueryFilter`,
`predicate: impl EntityPredicate<Q, F>` (any `Fn(ROQueryItem<Q>) -> bool`). The fake world holds the
bot (id 7), two players (1, 2), a zombie (3) and a cow (4); `Q` is `()` or `&EntityKindComponent`.

1671.name: AccountTrait
1671.docs: Real: `azalea::Account` (a cloneable handle that derefs to `dyn AccountTrait`).

1744.name: open_inventory
1744.docs: Open the player's inventory. Returns `None` if another container is open (the fake never has one).

913.name: entity
913.docs: Real: `azalea::entity` is `azalea_entity` (`EntityKindComponent(pub EntityKind)` derefs to the kind).

1740.name: open_container_at_with_timeout_ticks
1740.docs:
Open a container in the world, or time out after a specified amount of ticks. The fake errors below y=0
(real: the world read fails).

28.name: into
28.docs: Calls `U::from(self)`. That is, this conversion is whatever the implementation of [From]<T> for U chooses to do.

1736.name: component
1736.docs:
Get a component from this client. Real: `component<T: Component>` returning a `MappedRwLockReadGuard<T>`
(derefs to `T`); the fake only knows `Inventory` and returns a clone.

1759.name: world
1759.docs: Get an `RwLock` with a reference to our (potentially shared) Minecraft world.

1809.name: physics
1809.docs: Returns the complete `Physics` data for this entity.

1732.name: account
1732.docs: Returns the `Account` for our client (infallible, like the real one).

1832.name: azalea
1832.docs: Fake azalea: just enough surface (same shapes as the real one) to compile-check generated bindings.

1805.name: minecraft_id
1805.docs: Get the Minecraft ID of this entity.

1728.name: entity_by_minecraft_id
1728.docs: Get an `EntityRef` in the world by its `MinecraftEntityId`.

770.name: container
770.docs:
Real: `azalea::container` (azalea/src/container.rs). `ContainerHandle` derefs to `ContainerHandleRef` and
closes the container when dropped; the fake prints when that happens.

1801.name: attack
1801.docs: Attack this entity from the client that created this `EntityRef`.

1724.name: EntityRef
1724.docs: A reference to an entity in a world (real: `azalea::entity_ref::EntityRef`, re-exported at the root).

1647.name: Attributes
1647.docs: Real: `azalea_entity::Attributes`, one pub `AttributeInstance` field per attribute.

1747.name: nearest_entities
1747.docs:
Returns an array of `EntityRef` for all known entities that match the given filter, sorted by nearest first.
(Real: generic over `F: QueryFilter`; the fake has the same shape.)

1770.name: health
1770.docs: Get the health of this client.

1216.name: RwLock
1216.docs:
Stand-in for `parking_lot::RwLock`, which `Client::world()` really returns inside an `Arc`: `read()` gives a
guard directly (no `Result`), which is how real code calls `world.read().get_block_state(..)`.

1743.name: set_client_information
1743.docs: Change the client information; the real one also sends a packet when logged in. The fake prints it.

912.name: FakeQuery
912.docs: Stand-in for bevy's `QueryData` in the fake: how to turn a world row into the predicate's argument.

1766.name: attributes
1766.docs: Returns the attribute values of our player.

1739.name: open_container_at
1739.docs: Open a container in the world, like a chest. Times out after 5 seconds (100 ticks).
